reason: Critical gaps remain versus the specification (no epidemic dynamics, incorrect parameter mapping, missing key metrics). With 2 iterations left, a focused next pass can deliver the minimal SIR coupling, correct parameter/metric mapping, and supply/equity metrics—yielding substantial improvement and enabling meaningful evaluation.

specific_areas: Implement minimal discrete-time SIR epidemic module coupled to mask use and compute daily incident_cases, Rt, peak_incidence, and cumulative_infections_averted with a no-mask counterfactual.

Map spec parameter names to internal parameters: simulation_duration_days, initial_mask_adoption_rate, rewiring_rate, enforcement_probability, mandate_active, retailer_initial_stock_per_1000, retail_restock_rate_per_day; prefer data.parameters as the canonical source and honor it for steps.
Add masks_purchased and stockout_events metrics; detect stockout if inventory hits zero at any point in the day (independent of purchase attempts).
Compute subgroup_adoption_gap as top vs bottom income quintile difference and expose under the exact metric name.
Fix Watts–Strogatz odd-degree construction to achieve exact average_degree when k is odd.
Return new metrics in observable and evaluate(), and update CLI/default steps to read parameters.simulation_duration_days.

data_analysis.adjustments: Parse inputs from data.parameters first; implement explicit key mapping and validation with defaults; add checks that required spec parameters are recognized and logged.

model_planning.adjustments: Scope a minimal but complete SIR coupling with mask efficacy (source control and wearer protection) and infectious_period; plan a no-mask counterfactual path for infections averted; defer advanced entities (Households, multiple Retailers, SocialNetwork class) unless time remains after core gaps.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement SIR state arrays and per-step updates; integrate mask efficacy into transmission; add metric tracking (incident_cases, Rt, peak_incidence, infections_averted, masks_purchased, stockout_events, subgroup_adoption_gap); correct odd-degree network construction; update parameter extraction and steps handling.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Return new metrics in evaluate() under exact spec names; validate that health metrics are plausible (non-negative, correct lengths) and that equity metrics compute on final-day adoption.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Report any unmapped or ignored spec parameters; summarize epidemic outcomes (peak_incidence, Rt trend) and supply/equity metrics succinctly; flag if model ran without masks or without epidemic coupling.
